description:
About the Role 

 iCapital is seeking an Associate Python Developer to join the growing Core Operations Technology team. This individual will have foundational experience in Python programming and a passion for building scalable, high-performance applications. This roles collaborates with senior developers and cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions.

   

 Responsibilities 

 
 Develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications and scripts.

 Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following best practices.

 Debug and resolve issues in existing code.

 Collaborate with team members on code reviews, design discussions, and agile development processes.

 Participate in the development of REST APIs, web services, and data processing pipelines.

 Assist in writing unit tests and automated test cases to ensure quality and performance.

 Support the integration of third-party libraries and APIs.

 Maintain version control using Git and follow CI/CD practices.

 Work with Lambda functions for serverless computing tasks.

 Manage and interact with AWS S3 buckets for file storage and retrieval.

 Stay updated with emerging technologies and contribute ideas for improvements.

 
  

 Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience

 1-2 years of Python development experience, including Python, web scraping tools (Playwright, Selenium), REST APIs, JSON, and Git

 Working knowledge of SQL and databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Linux and Unix environments, and web frameworks such as Flask or Django

 Experience with AWS services, including Lambda, S3, and serverless application development; familiar with Azure or GCP is a plus

 Exposure to testing frameworks such as pytest and unittest, Docker, front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), and Agile methodologies

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to quality

 
  

 Benefits 

   

 The base salary range for this role is $85,000 to $110,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

  

 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

   

 For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/ 

   

 iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
